images.title: A perpendicular from a point outside a line
images.purpose: Show the construction of the perpendicular from a point P to a line, using one arc and then two equal arcs.
images.composition: A horizontal line near the bottom, P above it, the perpendicular dropping from P.
exact_structure: A long horizontal dark line near the bottom of the frame.
A point P above the line, labelled P.
A grey (#6B7280) arc centred at P cutting the line at X and Y, labelled X and Y; PX and PY drawn dashed with one tick mark each.
Below the line, a grey (#6B7280) arc centred at X and a grey (#6B7280) arc centred at Y, of the same radius, crossing at Q, labelled Q.
A teal (#0072B2) line from P through Q, meeting the line at M, labelled M, with a small square right angle mark at M.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: P and Q are each equally far from X and Y, so PQ is the perpendicular bisector of XY.
